turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class instead of from a phone call to me?
"Heard." Hearing isn't answering, Hale. Tell me whose decision the zero was, and point me to the line in your own procedure that let it go into the gradebook before anyone called me.
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Then put the facts on the table, Hale, because I haven't seen one yet. I'm writing down what you just said about lawyers, and I'll be reading it to the principal after this.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.

My son doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat. You've now called him a cheater and me his accomplice, with nothing in your hands but a machine's guess. Show me a document, or we finish this in the principal's office.
